prompts.ridge: A single isolated wide ruined roadside viaduct in fine restrained pixel art for a 32px tile side-scrolling game. Transparent background. Width roughly3times height. Continuous low slate-blue earthen ridge filling bottom15percent, with broken dark blue-gray masonry retaining walls growing out of it, three irregularly spaced ruined low bridge piers and one short sagging old wooden fence. Sparse small olive grasses integrated into masonry joints. Tallest ruin at left one third, lower fragments toward right. This is a MID DISTANCE scenery layer, quiet desaturated cool blue gray, low contrast, muted tiny edges, broad calm stone faces, crisp small pixel clusters not blur. Every stone fragment rests on the continuous ridge beneath it; no floating objects. The entire upper silhouette is transparent. Bottom is solid terrain extending to both sides and flat bottom for hiding behind gameplay earth. No sky, no cloud, no flowers, no characters, no trees, no arches, no glowing parts, no front platform, no text. Intended native size1000x240, background for abandoned roadside terraces and crossing.
prompts.gallery: One production game rear architectural wall, front orthographic elevation, landscape 2.08:1. Fine dark restrained pixel art matching Underworld blue-gray stone and old muted brown oak. This is a rear wall of an abandoned roadside guard gallery. Exact full rectangular panel all edges contained. Heavy dark oak lintel along top, two narrow masonry end piers at left and right edges, low uninterrupted stone parapet filling bottom30percent. Three unequal broad vertical rectangular open window bays above parapet, separated by slender oak posts with small diagonal corner braces. Window holes genuinely transparent; canvas outside structure transparent. Absolutely no sky or scenic painting inside windows. The central bay broadest and calm. No curved arches. No perspective floor. The very bottom is a straight continuous stone baseline intended to sit on an existing game floor. Top lintel flush under existing roof. Keep quiet dark matte blue-gray stone body, sparse desaturated olive moss at sill joints, small warm worn timber edges. This is behind characters, not a bright ornate landmark. No lamps, gears, banners, text, characters, furniture, floor, or foreground grass. Native intended dimensions800x384 at44px character height. Structurally credible, shallow wall depth, fine clustered pixel texture, restrained highlights, no black outlines, no blur, no painterly texture.
prompts.town: Create a single integrated distant village-row sprite for a side-scrolling fine pixel art game matching Underworld blue-gray stone, muted weathered oak and olive moss. Transparent background. Extra wide landscape3:1. Three modest inhabited cottages and one open workshop in one continuous architectural cluster, varied roof heights, slate-blue roofs with sparse moss, plaster and stone walls, small doors, warm dim amber windows, a very short clothesline with two muted cloths, stacked firewood under one eave. The whole cluster sits on its own single continuous low blue-gray stone foundation with a flat baseline. No individual floating buildings. Keep all roof edges inside image, generous transparent margin at top and both ends. This is a BACK ROW behind the playable town street, no foreground platform, no people, no trees, no signs or text, no large clock or tower. Buildings should have natural human proportions; final displayed width about1000worldpixels and height260px with44px tall hero. Fine crisp pixel clusters, quiet broad surfaces, sparse highlights at joints. Low contrast cool slate and dusty brown, windows small and restrained, do not dominate the hero. Not a bright colorful toy village or painterly concept art. Flat front elevation, shallow roofs, coherent connected settlement, visible feeling people live here but passage and interactive foreground will be added by the game. Transparent sky and all negative space, opaque masonry foundation.
prompts.town_final_edit: Edit this exact village-row sprite, keep its composition, proportions, pixel style and transparent background unchanged. Give it only a LITTLE more age and quiet decline, not devastation: faded cooler plaster with sparse fine cracks, a few missing or mismatched roof slates, one modest repaired plank shutter, slightly sagging clothesline, one unlit boarded side window. Keep only two or three small dim amber lights. No extra houses, stalls, signs, flags, people, trees or decorations. Avoid prosperity, bright commercial-street colors and pristine walls. Still safe, inhabited and cared for, people keeping a tired old village alive. Preserve continuous foundation baseline, crisp blue-gray stone, muted brown wood, tiny olive moss, no dramatic ruin or collapsed roofs. All alpha and canvas framing retained.
prompts.station_sparse_final: Edit the weathered row into two small separated one-story cottages at opposite ends, remove all central houses/sheds/connecting foundations, central50% transparent. Preserve slate/plaster/timber style and door scale, own low stone footings at same baseline, chipped plaster and dull moss, one tiny dim warm window. No shops/banners/ground across gap.
